description: Anonymous public Amazon.com catalog XHR scope. Search/detail documents and observed UI XHRs do not satisfy the required API operations. See references/retail-amazon-contracts.json and verification/retail-amazon-live-2026-10-05.json.

capabilities.title: Search products through a reusable anonymous XHR response
capabilities.blocker: The observed /s?k=... search results were document HTML; no search result data XHR was captured.

capabilities.title: Read a product's title, image and canonical URL from a validated anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: A detail-page vendor JSON GET was observed once, but direct replay returned 415. Its exact Accept header was not captured; later detail visits reached Continue shopping.

capabilities.title: List or filter product categories through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: No category data XHR was observed in the bounded anonymous journey.

capabilities.title: Page through result data with a verified continuation contract
capabilities.blocker: No result pagination data XHR or termination contract was observed.

capabilities.title: Distinguish current/list price, coupon, currency and stock from product data
capabilities.blocker: The product entity was not independently replayed, so no price or availability semantics are verified.

capabilities.title: Read homepage card fragments from anonymous XHR when useful
capabilities.blocker: The streaming XHR replayed but its 10 encrypted inputs came from the browser page; their engine-free acquisition is unverified, and sampled cards contained no product paths or price nodes.

capabilities.title: Acquire a personal Amazon login
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested anonymous public reads without login.

capabilities.title: Read or edit an Amazon account profile
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Personal account/profile operations are outside this anonymous public-read scope.

capabilities.title: Change a cart or address
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Cart and address writes are outside the requested read-only scope.

capabilities.title: Place an order or send a message
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Ordering and messaging are outside the requested read-only scope.

capabilities.title: Use the credentialed Associates Creators API
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Creators API requires Associates eligibility and API credentials; this request is limited to anonymous public XHR.
